blocks.text: It remains to be seen whether the Philippines and the United States will sign the proposed Pax Silica agreement during US President Donald Trump’s upcoming visit to the country, Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) Secretary Ma. Theresa Lazaro said Monday.
